# F013 — QSourceTool has no code consumers; it is reachable only via the auto-generated TOOL_REGISTRY ("q_source", "qsource")
## Summary
Outside its own module and `build/` artefacts, `QSourceTool` is referenced only by `parrot_tools/__init__.py::TOOL_REGISTRY` under two keys (`"q_source"`, `"qsource"`); `QueryToolkit` is registered as `"query"`. The registry file is **auto-generated by `scripts/generate_tool_registry.py`** — the refactor must regenerate it (rename/remove keys) rather than hand-edit. `parrot_tools/abstract.py` and `parrot_tools/toolkit.py` are one-line re-export shims to core (`parrot.tools.abstract`, `parrot.tools.toolkit`); new code should import from core directly.
